newsitem.title: USA: U.S. airlines slashed spring/summer fares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. airlines slashed spring/summer fares.

text.p: Many U.S. airlines cut fares for spring and summer travel throughout the U.S. and Canada and to Europe and Latin America, following the lead of Continental Airlines Inc.
Continental today cut its fares by up to 50 percent on regular 21-day advance-purchase tickets bought by February 14. The airline said the fare cuts apply to trips through September 30.

Fares to Latin America require no advance purchase, and tickets to Europe require three-day advance purchase, Continental said. The last date of the fare sale for travel to Latin America and Europe varies depending on destination.
Delta Air Lines Inc and AMR Corp's American Airlines said they were "responding competitively" in markets where they compete with Continental.
Northwest Airlines Corp also said it was matching Continental fare cuts in competing markets.
Trans World Airlines Inc also said it would match the Continental fares.
